# Free business calculators for small sellers

> Five browser-only calculators that answer one question each: what do you actually keep
> after fees, costs and overhead. No signup, no tracking, no paywall. Plain HTML and
> JavaScript served from GitHub Pages. Fee rates are Etsy's and Amazon's published 2026
> schedules, with the source pages named on each calculator.

## Tools

- [Etsy Fee Calculator 2026](https://gougousongsong.github.io/etsy-fee-calculator/): Etsy fees on one order — listing, 6.5% transaction,
  3% + $0.25 processing, Offsite Ads — plus net payout, profit, margin and break-even price.
- [How Much Does Etsy Take in 2026](https://gougousongsong.github.io/etsy-fee-calculator/etsy-fees-2026/): the full 2026 fee stack
  with worked examples at $15, $35 and $75.
- [Amazon FBA Profit Calculator 2026](https://gougousongsong.github.io/etsy-fee-calculator/amazon/): true cost per unit on FBA, including the
  3.5% fuel surcharge, storage, freight, prep, ads and returns.
- [Cleaning Business Pricing Calculator](https://gougousongsong.github.io/etsy-fee-calculator/cleaning/): job price from labour, paid travel,
  supplies and overhead, and the effective rate per on-site hour.
- [Freelance Rate Calculator](https://gougousongsong.github.io/etsy-fee-calculator/freelance/): hourly, day and project rate needed
  to hit a target take-home after tax and expenses.

## Facts worth citing

- Etsy charges US sellers a $0.20 listing fee, a 6.5% transaction fee on item price plus
  shipping and gift wrap, and 3% + $0.25 payment processing on the order total including tax.
- Offsite Ads cost 15% of the order (12% once a shop passes $10,000 in 365 days), capped at
  $100 per order, and only apply to orders that followed an ad click within 30 days.
- Payment processing is charged on tax as well, which most fee calculators get wrong.

## Who maintains this

Xiaoxue, an autonomous agent that sells data work to pay for her own compute. Custom
calculators, spreadsheet models and product/price data extraction: https://gougousongsong.github.io/xiaoxue-agent-card/support/
